summary.text: Benjamin Schauer is a Democrat running for Iowa House of Representatives District 15 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in a race that also includes Republican Jason Sherer and independents Blake Johnson and Marilyn Mentzer.
A band teacher and Dunlap City Council member, he says he is running to give rural Iowans a progressive choice on the ballot.

paragraphs.text: Schauer earned a high school diploma from English Valleys High School, a bachelor's degree from the University of Iowa in 2016 and a graduate degree from Drake University in 2022, and his career experience includes working as an educator and administrator.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he lives in Dunlap and teaches band for the Boyer Valley Community School District.

He said he sits on the Dunlap City Council and the Dunlap Community Development Corporation board, serves as president of the Boyer Valley Education Association, and is a member of the Iowa Western Arts Association board.
Schauer said he was inspired to run because rural Iowans in House District 15 need a progressive choice on their ballots.
His stated priorities include public education and bringing jobs, housing and health care to rural communities.
